review_candidates.title: Senior API Gateway Engineer (Kong)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Purpose The Senior API Gateway Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, administering, and supporting enterprise API Gateway solutions using Kong Gateway. Key Accountabilities Design, configure, deploy, and administer Kong Gateway environments across development, testing, and production platforms. Troubleshoot gateway-related issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement performance optimization initiatives. Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedure
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum Experience +5 years of experience in API Management, Middleware, Integration Platforms, or Enterprise Integration technologies. Strong hands-on experience with Kong Gateway administration and implementation.
